teaser: Hands already inside the panel before anyone has said it's broken — that is where life path 33 meets ISTP, screwdriver mid-turn, attention already past the fix. The 33 carries a pull toward healing and teaching on a scale most numbers do not ask for; ISTP works through things with its hands, quietly, wanting no audience while doing it. The crossing is a teacher who would rather repair the wiring than explain it. A vast, almost parental care, carried by someone built to show it through fixing instead of speaking it.
excerpt: The toolbox stays in the trunk, just in case.
